name: Baba Lysaga's Creeping Hut
condition_immunities: Blinded; Charmed; Deafened; Exhaustion; Frightened; Paralyzed; Petrified; Prone

actions.name: Multiattack
actions.desc: The hut makes three attacks with its roots. It can replace one of these attacks with a rock attack.

actions.name: Root
actions.desc: Melee Weapon Attack: +12 to hit, reach 60 ft., one target. Hit: 30 (4d10 + 8) bludgeoning damage.

actions.name: Rock
actions.desc: Ranged Weapon Attack: +12 to hit, range 120 ft., one target. Hit: 21 (3d8 + 8) bludgeoning damage.

special_abilities.name: Constructed Nature
special_abilities.desc: An animated object doesn't require air, food, drink, or sleep. The magic that animates an object is dispelled when the construct drops to 0 hit points. An animated object reduced to 0 hit points becomes inanimate and is too damaged to be of much use or value to anyone.

special_abilities.name: Antimagic Susceptibility
special_abilities.desc: The hut is incapacitated while the magic gem that animates it is in the area of an antimagic field. If targeted by dispel magic, the hut must succeed on a Constitution saving throw against the caster's spell save DC or fall unconscious for 1 minute.

special_abilities.name: Siege Monster
special_abilities.desc: The hut deals double damage to objects and structures.
